card.name: Final noun ending an English idiom
card.fires_on: The last word of a fixed English idiom, such as table in "bring to the table" or curve in "ahead of the curve". It fires in general web prose, not drug text.

modes.label: Idiom ending after "the"
modes.description: A noun completing a stock phrase that begins with "the".

modes.label: Idiom ending after other words
modes.description: A noun or word piece finishing a set phrase, such as fell by the wayside or creative juices.

card.plain: It marks the final word of a common saying, where the phrase is already complete.
